description: Zone 3 server-side MIME validation configuration for Dataverse plugin. Defines allowed file types with magic byte signatures and blocked executable signatures. Supports compliance with FINRA 4511 and SEC 17a-4 by providing defense-in-depth file type validation for Enterprise Managed environments.

allowedTypes.description: Tagged Image File Format (little-endian and big-endian)
Plain text — validated by absence of binary content in first 8192 bytes
Comma-separated values — validated by absence of binary content
Office Open XML Spreadsheet (PK zip archive with [Content_Types].xml)
Office Open XML Document (PK zip archive with [Content_Types].xml)
Office Open XML Presentation (PK zip archive with [Content_Types].xml)
